rules.statement: A beneficiary cannot initiate an action for partition, only the trustee can do so.
rules.supporting_quote: "The trustee is the person who can institute an action for partition for he is vested with title; a beneficiary cannot [ Daniel v. Saranelis Appu, (1903) 7 N. L. R. 163. ; Silva v. Silva, (1916) 19 N. L. R. 47]."
